title: Daily Reading Output (daily-reading-v5)
description: The published artifact and the public response shapes for a constrained-model reading. Supersedes daily-reading-v3 for new readings; stored v3 records remain readable through their own versioned reader and are never rewritten to look new. The reader-facing composition is deliberately the incumbent one — a quiet kicker over a focal lead, then supporting paragraphs — because the publisher changed, not the product. What v5 removes is what v5 no longer has: there is no editorial release behind it, so release_version is gone; there is no reviewed fallback copy, so fallback_used and the safety_fallback role are gone; and because a model wrote the prose, the disclosure that says so is required rather than optional.

paragraphRoleV5.description: Fixed order. primary_theme is always first and always present: it is the lead the model was asked for, and a reading without one has nothing to be about. safety_fallback is absent by design — v5 has no reviewed copy to fall back to, and an unavailable reading says so honestly instead.

order.description: 1-based, contiguous, strictly increasing across the paragraph list.

text.description: Model-written prose that passed every deterministic check. Every astrological claim in it resolves to a calculated fact through this paragraph's evidence.

generated_at.description: The command's frozen generation_anchor, not the attempt time. A pre-generated edition therefore reports the instant it was frozen, which is before its own local day starts.

headline.description: Rendered as the quiet primary-theme kicker so the lead stays the visual focal point. Never a heading: it labels the paragraph below it.

disclosure.description: The visible statement that a model wrote this prose, naming the service that actually wrote it. Required, not optional: a reader cannot consent to something the product then declines to mention. A stored disclosure is never rewritten when the routing changes, so readings published under different transports carry different sentences and both remain true.

paragraphs.description: Never empty, and always opens with primary_theme.

evidence_url.description: Relative path to GET /v1/readings/{id}/evidence. Required on v5 rather than optional: when a model wrote the prose, 'why this?' is part of the artifact, not an extra.
